blockingIssues.problem: The idea lists the audience as "Library patrons with West Room reservations; general public," but the source explicitly frames the notice for borrowers who already reserved a tool. There is no support in the source for treating the general public as an intended audience.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: "The library needs a notice for borrowers with an existing tool reservation for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source assigns the notice to borrowers with existing reservations; incidental public availability alone does not establish a broader intended audience.
